thread:
sasha: Opening a small docs PR: dedicated provisioning quickstart + migration notes + SDK + CLI snippets + fix a broken runbook link. Can reviewers take a quick look?

ryan: Quick ask: include a tiny 'migration gotchas' section mapping old reserved keys to new dedicated keys. Also note affinity semantics.

sasha: Draft YAML and short Python/CLI samples included in PR. YAML shows tenant_labels, affinity: prefer, autoscale_policy (min_replicas/max_replicas/cooldown), and fallback: shared_pool.

lia_docs: Micro-nit: add one sentence clarifying "affinity: prefer" != strict isolation and add a compatibility note for SDK <0.9 using min_instances.

mike_eng: Runtime note: avoid deprecated tenant keys; prefer tenant_labels. Also good to show explicit fallback behavior.

deploy-bot: Link scan: PR #4620 contains broken link /docs/provisioning (404). Suggested replacement: /runbooks/dedicated-provisioning-handbook.

sasha: Thanks — updated links, added compatibility paragraph and the fallback example. Assigning @lia_docs @ryan for review; plan to merge after microcopy pass and a quick SDK sanity run. ETA EOD.
